summary: EVAVO's reusable bounded multi-tenant website-chat Worker, isolated browser widget, reviewed Workers AI model boundary, cached public knowledge and explicit visitor-consent lead-capture authority. Model chat cannot create leads or execute webhooks; administrator, browser-origin, bot-key, knowledge-refresh and follow-up consent boundaries remain separate and fail closed. Workers KV counters/indexes remain best-effort rather than transactional authority.

capabilities.title: Generate bounded website-chat responses
capabilities.description: Accept origin- or bot-key-authorised chat requests, apply the reviewed Workers AI chat-model and response-shape policy, combine curated/cached knowledge as untrusted evidence context and return bounded public-safe responses without allowing the model to create a lead or perform external actions.
requires: Exact approved browser Origin or valid non-browser bot key

capabilities.title: Refresh approved public knowledge cache
capabilities.description: Fetch configured public HTTPS knowledge sources only through the authenticated administrator refresh route with manual redirect validation, public-network/SSRF boundaries, full-operation timeout, streamed byte limits, binary rejection and source/final URL plus SHA-256 provenance.

capabilities.title: Capture explicit visitor-approved follow-up
capabilities.description: Store a bounded follow-up record only after the visitor sees the proposed contact/message evidence and sends exact boolean consent. Stored fields must be present in visitor-authored evidence; model chat cannot invoke or imply this authority, and KV coordination is not treated as transactional storage authority.

capabilities.title: Administer reviewed bot configuration
capabilities.description: Manage bounded bot configuration and cache state through bearer-authenticated administrator routes while never returning bot-key material and while rejecting retired webhook destinations/credentials and unsafe knowledge configuration.

capabilities.title: Run complete chat-platform source and bundle validation
capabilities.description: Run tracked-source secret safety, config-secret boundaries, runtime security, portable widget, Super EVA compatibility, TypeScript and Wrangler no-deploy bundle checks without publishing the Worker. A no-deploy bundle pass does not prove provider deployment or transactional KV coordination.
